title: Special Floor Area Regulations in C4-5X Districts
previewText: In C4-5X Districts within the Special District, the underlying floor area ratio for commercial uses shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the provisions of Section 33-122 (Commercial buildings in all other Commercial Districts) shall be modified to permit a maximum floor area ratio of 5.0.
